data.body: **P2 — Require ephemeral runners or make model-user setup reusable.** The new documentation implies ordinary self-hosted runners are supported, but every model-user preparation script unconditionally runs `adduser` under `set -e` and never removes the account or home. A persistent runner therefore succeeds once and then fails on subsequent jobs; retaining the home would also preserve model-writable state across runs. Securely recreate and clean up these users per job, or explicitly require fresh one-job runners such as CodeBuild.
